text: Android: a quarantined shopping-list item has no marker on its row, unlike an expense

Fixed in da106a0: shared BlockedBanner(code, who) extracted from the expense form and used by EditItemDialog; ItemRow shows the warning mark plus ErrorText.refusal(code) under the note line for a parked item (shopping and checklist share the row). No new strings; expense_not_saved kept as the generic heading. Three screen tests, each mutation-checked. unknown_list, which had no sentence on either client, became T-214. Gate green on main with this commit (server 461, web 406, Android).
